title: Free positions
purpose: List positions that are unblocked and unoccupied in active boxes, in the order a technician fills boxes. Nothing is reserved: a position is claimed only when an item is stored in it.
summary: Positions that are free and unblocked in active boxes, in the order boxes are filled.

tasks.title: Find the next free position
steps: Choose the [[Storage unit]], [[Rack or shelf]] or [[Box]], then select [[Apply]].
Read the path in [[Rack or shelf]] to locate the box within the unit. Select the first [[Position]] to open its cell in the box.

tasks.title: Download the list
steps: If the list reopens with a row limit message, choose a specific box and select [[Apply]] to narrow the download.

good_to_know: Nothing is reserved. A position is taken only when an item is stored in it.
The order is fixed so boxes fill in sequence. Columns cannot be sorted.
Retired boxes and structure are never included.

sections.title: Search, filters and sorting
paragraphs: Search matches part of the box code, ignoring capitals.
The list has no create button and no status filter: only active boxes under active structure are ever included.
Columns are not sortable. The order is fixed: unit code, rack path, box code, then position number, so boxes fill in sequence. Choose 25, 50 or 100 rows per page; the default is 25.

items.label: Rack or shelf
items.description: Limit to a rack or shelf and everything inside it.

items.label: Container type, Site, Room
items.description: Further limits, under the More control.

items.label: Position
items.description: Box code and position label; opens the box at that position. Always shown.

items.label: Rack or shelf
items.description: The full path from the top of the storage unit to the location holding the box. Select the path to open that location.

items.label: Container type
items.description: Hidden until chosen in the column menu.

items.label: Number
items.description: The position's ordinal in the box's numbering order.

items.label: Export CSV
items.description: Downloads all matching rows across pages as a UTF-8 CSV in the order shown. Anyone who can read this list can export it. Correct invalid filters or narrow the selection to 10,000 rows or fewer to see Export CSV. An empty selection downloads just the column headings. If the selection grows past 10,000 rows before you download, you return to this list with your filters. Narrow the selection and try again. Cells that a spreadsheet could read as a formula are prefixed with an apostrophe, and numbers are exact decimals. The audit trail records who exported the selection and the number of data rows in the CSV. An over-limit request produces no download or export event.

items.label: No free positions
items.description: Every position in an active box is occupied or blocked. Add a box, or unblock a position.

items.label: These filters cannot be applied
items.description: A filter value was not valid; no rows are shown. Correct the highlighted filter.
